title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: September 1, 2026 – Free Agency, Trades, and League Investigations

items.headline: Steph Curry Reaffirms Commitment to Warriors Amid Extension Talks
items.summary: Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry has reportedly shut down rumors of his potential exit, reconfirming his intent to retire with the team despite ongoing extension discussions.

items.headline: Clippers Under NBA Investigation, Kawhi Leonard Trade Paused
items.summary: The LA Clippers are reportedly facing an NBA investigation into potential salary-cap circumvention concerning Kawhi Leonard's sponsorship deals, which has put a hold on a potential trade involving the star forward.

items.headline: Jalen Brunson Delivers 'Reality Check' to Knicks
items.summary: Following a championship-winning season, Jalen Brunson has reportedly issued a 'blunt reality check' to the New York Knicks as the team prepares for the upcoming 2026-27 season.

items.headline: Brandon Williams Signs One-Year Deal with Warriors
items.summary: Guard Brandon Williams has agreed to a one-year, $2.6 million deal with the Golden State Warriors, adding backcourt depth for the upcoming season.

items.headline: Georges Niang Joins Golden State Warriors
items.summary: Veteran forward Georges Niang has signed a one-year deal to join the Golden State Warriors.

items.headline: Nick Richards Heads to Miami Heat on One-Year Deal
items.summary: Center Nick Richards has agreed to a one-year contract with the Miami Heat.

items.headline: DeMar DeRozan Set to Join Denver Nuggets
items.summary: Veteran scorer DeMar DeRozan is reportedly signing with the Denver Nuggets.

items.headline: Haywood Highsmith Returns to Phoenix Suns
items.summary: Forward Haywood Highsmith is returning to the Phoenix Suns.

items.headline: Knicks Sign Landry Shamet to Four-Year, $23.9M Deal
items.summary: The New York Knicks have reportedly inked guard Landry Shamet to a four-year contract worth approximately $23.9 million.

items.headline: Key Free Agents Still Available on the Market
items.summary: As the offseason progresses, top free agents including restricted free agent Jalen Duren, Cam Thomas, and Bruce Brown Jr. remain available and could significantly impact their next teams.

items.headline: Jonathan Kuminga Traded to Minnesota on Two-Year Deal
items.summary: Jonathan Kuminga has agreed to a two-year, $13 million deal after being traded to Minnesota from the Golden State Warriors.

items.headline: Celtics Trade Jaylen Brown to Philadelphia 76ers
items.summary: The Boston Celtics have reportedly traded star wing Jaylen Brown to the Philadelphia 76ers.

items.headline: Lakers Reportedly Shopping Dalton Knecht
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers are reportedly exploring trade opportunities for third-year forward Dalton Knecht ahead of the upcoming season.

items.headline: Cavaliers Eyeing Senegalese Center Khalifa Diop
items.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers are reportedly in pursuit of Senegalese center Khalifa Diop, who currently plays for Baskonia in Europe. The Cavaliers hold his draft rights from 2022.

items.headline: Ziaire Williams Excited to Join Lakers Alongside Luka Doncic and Bronny James
items.summary: New Lakers addition Ziaire Williams shared his excitement about joining the team, discussing expectations from leadership and the prospect of playing with Luka Doncic and reuniting with Bronny James.

items.headline: Ben Simmons' Potential NBA Return Sparks Interest
items.summary: As Ben Simmons aims for an NBA comeback, speculation is growing about where the former No. 1 overall pick might land.

items.headline: 2026-27 NBA Season Dates Confirmed
items.summary: The NBA has released its schedule for the 2026-27 season. Training camps are set to open on September 29, with preseason games beginning October 3. The regular season officially tips off on October 20.
